issue_title: Bump golangci-lint from v2.8.0 to v2.9.0
issue_body: golangci-lint v2.9.0 fixes a false positive we suppress by hand in two packages. Move every install site to v2.9.0: the CI workflow, the four release workflows and the gate image, keeping each install on the tagged install script.

plan.summary: Move every golangci-lint install site from the v2.8.0 tag to the v2.9.0 tag.

approach.description: In ci.yml and the four release workflows, change the install.sh URL tag and the installed version argument from v2.8.0 to v2.9.0.
In deploy/gate-image/Dockerfile, change the GOLANGCI_LINT_VERSION ARG default from v2.8.0 to v2.9.0.

verification.test_strategy: CI's lint job installs v2.9.0 from the tagged script; a local gate-image build reports golangci-lint 2.9.0.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Every golangci-lint install site names v2.9.0 and the tagged install script.
